purpose: Teach: トヨタ自動車/最年少/サバイバル/プラネタリウム/温存/微細/立て続け/頑丈

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、トヨタ自動車、絶対、研究、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, I have to say — the depth you brought to that Toyota research paper was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, direct praise. Open with his name to signal attention. Steady pace. The compliment lands clearly without being effusive. A teacher recognizing real work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。業界の、本気で、絶対、最年少、絶対、社長、絶対、インタビュー、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I was really grateful to find that interview with the youngest company president in the industry — it added such a rigorous layer to the research.
lines.style: Humble gratitude, but underneath it genuine pride in the work. Respectful toward the teacher. Words come carefully — he's choosing them. Slight emphasis on the specific detail that pleased him most.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後企業の、本気で、絶対、サバイバル、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And how you handled the postwar corporate survival angle — that showed real perspective. Genuinely thoughtful work.
lines.style: Steady, observant tone. She's noticing something specific and naming it. Not overpraising, but letting him know she saw the intelligence behind the choice. A moment of mutual recognition.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教育施設の、本気で、絶対、プラネタリウム、絶対、効果、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I was fortunate to locate that planetarium study on educational facility design — it really deepened the research in ways I hadn't anticipated.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in his voice. He's explaining his process, not just accepting praise. Thoughtful pacing. A hint of that awkward earnestness when he talks about work he actually cares about.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統技能の、本気で、絶対、温存、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The section on preserving traditional craftsmanship within modern industry — that was striking. You clearly did the work.
lines.style: Measured appreciation. She's moving through his paper with genuine attention. Not rushing. Each observation carries weight because she's actually read it closely.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。半導体の、本気で、絶対、微細、絶対、加工、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show how semiconductor precision manufacturing ties into that same thread of craftsmanship — it felt like an important connection to make in the research.
lines.style: Slightly more animated than before. He's explaining the logic of his choices. Still respectful, but warming to the conversation because she's asking the right questions. His voice carries the satisfaction of having made the connections work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、立て続け、絶対、の合併、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And you traced the consecutive industry mergers over that period — the structural angle. Really impressive synthesis.
lines.style: Recognition of a sophisticated choice. Her tone has the quality of someone reviewing work with a student who has genuinely surprised her in the best way. Deliberate, not rushed. Genuine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。建築の、本気で、絶対、頑丈、絶対、設計、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I felt the architectural design principles — especially the emphasis on structural integrity — gave me a framework to tie everything together. I'm grateful for the opportunity to work on this.
lines.style: Quiet conclusion. He's reached the end of his explanation and is stepping back respectfully. There's warmth in gratitude, but also the subtle note of someone relieved the conversation went well. Slight trailing-off, like he's giving her space to offer the final word.
